, , . Visual size is decoupled from heading level.

aria.value: No ARIA: the new-tab hint is visually hidden text inside the link, so it is part of the accessible name

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the link (native).

focus: Links show a color-focus-ring outline on :focus-visible (Highlight in forced colors).
notes: Links are always underlined, so they are not identified by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
Links that open a new tab say so in their accessible name (WCAG 3.2.5 advisory technique G201).
Heading level and visual size are independent, so the outline can be correct without compromising the design.
Truncated or clamped text remains in the DOM, so screen readers read it in full; sighted users need another way to see it.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) of the new-tab hint is pending.
